name: inbound_context
description: Read-only context for an inbound caller after they state their full name. Uses provider-bound call metadata, never caller-provided profile or attempt IDs. Unknown or unconfirmed callers receive no history. If several open incidents match, ask which one before selecting a returned case_id. Use returning_latest_call only when the caller explicitly says they are returning the most recent call. This does not record a report or authorize an outbound task.

confirmed_name.description: The full name the caller explicitly gave. Never invent or copy a name from an earlier call or directory hint.

returning_latest_call.description: True only when this caller explicitly says they are returning the most recent call; otherwise omit or false. Selecting this is not permission for another phone call.

case_id.description: Optional case_id returned in this tool's choices, selected after the caller identifies the incident. Empty or omitted initially. Never invent an ID or select another participant's case.
